justification: Experiment is completely leakage-free and grounded in genuine tracking data rather than deterministic synthetic simulation.
required_caveats: Target is an operational proxy (3.0m rule), not true intent.
Validation and test sets share the same match (Match 3) via chronological split, meaning match-specific tactics could inflate validation-test transfer.
Evaluator precision uses a hybrid formula that slightly penalises fragmentation.
